changelog:
Initial release — Agency Client Reporting & Retention Kit Generator.

- Generates client-facing reports, QBR narratives, health scorecards, and renewal/upsell proposals.
- Designed for digital agencies, consultants, and MSPs to support ROI proof, retention, and account growth.
- Includes 4 robust, structured prompt templates for core reporting and retention needs.
- Offers both free (monthly report) and paid tiers (full set), plus DFY (done-for-you) option.
- Focuses on narrative-rich outputs and actionable formats—no live data connections required.
summary: Generates tailored agency client reports, QBR narratives, health scorecards, and renewal proposals to prove ROI, retain clients, and grow accounts.
